learning_salience.rationale: dominant coverage of kp_cs230_ai_attack_taxonomy; the unit gives the lecture's organizing attack taxonomy and concretely broadens attack surfaces from raw inputs to instructions, context, and retrieval pipelines.

substantial coverage of gateway KP kp_cs230_input_space_optimization_for_adversarial_examples plus substantial coverage of kp_cs230_perceptual_constraints_for_adversarial_examples; this is a formula-heavy construction segment where gradients are taken with respect to pixels, then modified with closeness constraints and physical-patch objectives.

substantial coverage of gateway KP kp_cs230_high_dimensional_compounding_vulnerability with substantial coverage of critical/high KPs kp_cs230_fast_gradient_sign_method and kp_cs230_adversarial_defense_strategies; the segment is derivation-heavy and common-error-prone around compounding effects, gradient-sign perturbations, attacker assumptions, and defense tradeoffs.

substantial coverage of kp_cs230_backdoor_and_data_poisoning_attacks and kp_cs230_prompt_injection; the cat/dog trigger example and direct-versus-indirect prompt injection cases support scenario-based application questions, but the unit is more mechanism survey than derivation.

dominant coverage of gateway KP kp_cs230_generative_modeling_as_distribution_learning; the segment explicitly contrasts discriminative versus generative learning and states the central distribution-matching objective that the GAN and diffusion units build on.

dominant coverage of gateway KP kp_gan_latent_generator_distribution with partial support from gateway KP kp_gan_minimax_objective; the generator-discriminator game, latent-code mapping, and gradient flow through D to G are core GAN mechanics.

substantial coverage of gateway KP kp_gan_minimax_objective and substantial coverage of kp_gan_instability_diagnostics; the unit derives discriminator and generator losses, explains saturating versus non-saturating updates, and directly treats mode collapse and training instability.

dominant coverage of kp_cs230_forward_diffusion_process, with GAN instability used as explicit motivation for diffusion; the forward noising recurrence and the contrast with GAN mode collapse make this a foundational bridge into diffusion.

dominant coverage of gateway KP kp_diffusion_denoising_intuition with prerequisite support from kp_cs230_forward_diffusion_process; the reconstruction loss, self-supervised triplets, and denoising target are central training mechanics for diffusion.

substantial coverage of kp_cs230_diffusion_sampling_and_conditioning and gateway KP kp_latent_diffusion_models; the unit connects denoising mechanics to inference-time sampling, prompt conditioning, latent-space efficiency, and video extensions, but it is broader and less derivational than the preceding objectives.
